title: Square and press a twenty-way IDC ribbon connection
instruction: Place the ribbon into the connector with its red stripe at pin one. Keep it square while pressing the handle down to close the connector.
context: The Brooks PreciseFlex G6000 controller uses a 20-way IDC connector for its remote manual-control pendant adapter. The unpowered bench trial assembles the IDC end and uses a passive straight-through fixture to detect opens, shorts and crossed wires.
setup: Use the keyed 20-position TE 1658621-4 socket, the AMP-LATCH replacement for the 746285-4 named by Brooks, with 28 AWG 3M 3365/20 ribbon at 1.27 mm conductor pitch. For the physical trial mount the TE 91085-2 manual arbor frame with the 768338-1 base and 768341-1 receptacle tooling. Place the 30 mm socket at x=463 mm and y=47 mm with its cap open and pin one toward positive y. The square-cut ribbon end starts outside the slot. Its other end is terminated to the passive tester adapter. Adjust ram height and record the closed height on a correctly terminated sample of the same connector, following assets/PROTOCOL.md.
scoring: Score 0.50 when all twenty conductors are registered in their grooves and the red stripe is at pin one with the cut end fully through the open cap slot. To score 1.00, maintain that registration with the cap square within 2 degrees and within 0.45 mm of its reference shut height for one second. Then verify continuity on all twenty conductors and isolation between adjacent contacts on the completed termination using the passive tester. Score 0.00 for incorrect registration, a detached cap, a damaged socket or ribbon, or a mechanically completed termination with an open, crossed or shorted circuit.
fidelity: The recorded PanaVise 502 rig uses a native lever and guided platen with a 3M 89120-0101 model for the same two-row, 2.54 mm IDC interface and 1.27 mm cable pitch. The physical test uses the TE connector and its specified manual arbor tooling for the same square, guided press stroke. Two articulated cable sections approximate tape flex. The simulator verifies registration and mechanical closure, and the physical trial checks electrical continuity and isolation after closure.
scores: Dream-1 beta run: 0.00; scripted native-contact demo: 1.00
